post.caption: A pastor handed over a huge diamond. In March 2017, diggers on the team of Pastor Emmanuel Momoh found a rough diamond of 709 carats in Sierra Leone's Kono district. Momoh handed it to the local authorities, and President Ernest Bai Koroma thanked him for not smuggling it. It was named the Peace Diamond and was the biggest found in Sierra Leone in over 40 years. The government held an open auction in New York, run for free by the Rapaport Group, and the British jeweler Graff bought it on December 4, 2017.
